descriptions.text: Far from Earth, Ryland Grace wakes on a spacecraft without knowing what brought him there. He gradually discovers that he is the only surviving member of a mission whose outcome could determine humanity’s survival. Recovering his memories is only part of the problem: he must also understand an unfamiliar scientific threat. The novel follows his attempts to investigate it with the limited resources available to him.

descriptions.text: Bilbo Baggins is drawn away from his quiet home when Gandalf and a company of dwarves ask him to join their expedition. They want to recover treasure guarded by the dragon Smaug, but reaching it means crossing unfamiliar and dangerous places. Bilbo must take on responsibilities he never expected. The adventure tests whether someone who values comfort can find a place among companions with a very different purpose.

Als een getuige zijn vrouw Silvia met de plek in verband brengt, richten verdenkingen zich ook op haar. Silvia ontkent dat ze verantwoordelijk is. descriptions.text: Geralt trekt als hekser door een wereld waarin mensen bescherming zoeken tegen monsters. Zijn training en bijzondere vermogens maken hem geschikt voor gevaarlijke opdrachten, maar niet iedere ontmoeting laat zich eenvoudig beoordelen. Achter een afschrikwekkend uiterlijk kunnen andere motieven schuilgaan. In deze verhalen komen magie en dreiging samen met de vraag hoe Geralt moet handelen wanneer menselijkheid en monsterlijkheid niet langs vanzelfsprekende grenzen verdeeld zijn.

descriptions.text: Evangeline Fox hopes to prevent the man she loves from marrying someone else. She turns to the Prince of Hearts and accepts a bargain: his help in return for three kisses, given when and where he chooses. What seems a way to recover her happy ending soon leaves her facing another person's ambitions. Dealing with an immortal makes the limits of that agreement difficult to see, and each promised payment carries implications she did not anticipate.
